channel.title: Business Insider France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: How wealthy people are getting out of the Middle East: $200,000 charter flights and chauffeured drives across borders
item.description: With air strikes and escalating tensions, those in financial hubs like Dubai and Abu Dhabi are spending six figures to safely evacuate.

item.title: I flew to Dubai for my 30th birthday. Now I'm stranded 8,000 miles from home and terrified after the US strikes on Iran.
item.description: Shanice Day, a Houston native, faces challenges returning from Dubai after a US-Israel strike on Iran disrupted her birthday trip plans.

item.title: Satellite image shows Iran's largest naval vessel, a tanker-turned-base ship, smoking in port
item.description: US officials said the Iranian navy was a top target at the start of combat operations over the weekend.

item.title: The US Embassy in Riyadh was attacked by 2 drones, Saudi Arabia says
item.description: US Embassy in Riyadh was struck by drones, resulting in a small fire and some damage to the building, Saudi Arabia officials said.

item.title: A few dozen flights resumed after 3 days of chaos. Some are still canceling or turning around as confusion persists.
item.description: 12 Etihad Airways flights departed Abu Dhabi, while Emirates said it would operate "a limited number of flights" on Monday evening.

item.title: Sam Altman says OpenAI will tweak its Pentagon deal after surveillance backlash
item.description: Sam Altman posted an internal memo that OpenAI is working with the Pentagon to "make some additions" to their agreement.

item.title: Here's what current and former OpenAI employees are saying about the company's Pentagon deal
item.description: Current and former OpenAI staff have aired their views about the company's Pentagon deal, raising concerns about safety guardrails and transparency.

item.title: What to do if you're an American in the Middle East right now
item.description: Americans are being told to shelter in place in Middle Eastern countries including Iran, Qatar, and the UAE after the US and Israel struck Iranian cities including the capital, Tehran.

item.title: I'm raising 2 kids in Abu Dhabi. I'm not panicking — but I feel powerless.
item.description: Bo Jablonski and her husband are living abroad in the United Arab Emirates. They're being careful about what they tell their kids about the war.

item.title: Amazon says 3 data centers were damaged by drone strikes in the Middle East
item.description: Amazon AWS data centers in UAE and Bahrain hit by drone strikes amid US-Iran tensions, causing power and infrastructure disruptions.
